title: Alley/Sidewalk/Street Repair - Hazardous
description: Use this service request to report hazardous alley, sidewalk, and street conditions that could cause bodily injury or damage to a vehicle. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.

branches.Alley: Alley problem, surface, optional damage/injury question
branches.Street: Repair location, street repair type, optional direction of travel

observedQuestions.prompt: What is the nature of the problem?

branches.Ruts in alley: Guidance: ruts on pavement continue; ruts in dirt off pavement use Sanitation Property Damage

observedQuestions.prompt: Has there been any property damage or injury? (If yes, enter a notice of claim for Risk Management online)

branches.Yes: Validation Alert: If there is property damage - please visit Risk Management website to file a claim of notice

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a hazardous alley, sidewalk, curb, or street repair.
actions.why: Report a hazardous alley, sidewalk, curb, or street condition that could cause bodily injury or vehicle damage. The 311 request form distinguishes alley breakdowns, ruts, standing water, and potholes; broken, raised, sunken, or root-damaged sidewalks and curbs; and street repairs such as potholes, bridges, gutters, culverts, shoulders, retaining walls, grading, and wheelchair ramps. It asks whether the person owns the property for sidewalk concerns.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Alley/Sidewalk/Street Repair - Hazardous" requests is not the route the 311 request form recommends for ruts in dirt off the alley pavement. If those dirt ruts were caused by a Sanitation truck, then submit a "Sanitation Property Damage" 311 request instead.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Alley/Sidewalk/Street Repair - Hazardous"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Alley/Sidewalk/Street Repair - Hazardous"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for dirt-alley damage caused by a Sanitation truck.
actions.why: For hazardous ruts in dirt off the alley pavement when a Sanitation truck caused the property damage. The 311 request form for "Alley/Sidewalk/Street Repair - Hazardous" requests directs dirt ruts to Sanitation Property Damage, whose saved description limits it to damage caused by Sanitation trucks.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation Property Damage"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation Property Damage"

actions.tagline: Visit the Risk Management website to file a notice of claim for damage or injury.
actions.why: For property damage or injury associated with a hazardous alley condition. The 311 request form asks whether there has been property damage or injury and directs people who answer Yes to enter a notice of claim for Risk Management online.
actions.how: Visit the Risk Management website to file a notice of claim
actions.how_formatted: Visit the [Risk Management website](https://live.origamirisk.com/Origami/Incidents/New?_collectionLinkItemID=1&IncidentTypeID=10002) to file a notice of claim
